Main text in one column at centre-left, with marginal notes in the right margin (printed as side notes, small type) and a few notes in the left margin. Heading "Articulus II. DE DILUVIO UNIVERSALI" in the middle of the text block. Left-edge fragments of the facing page are not transcribed.

main_text.p: architecturam, edium fracationes, Leges Politi- cas &c. Babylonii didiciffe dicuntur, exorta eft fabula.

At Gelaladin Arabs fedecim Ægypti Reges ad diluvium usque recenset, ex quibus Nacraus Magiæ peritus, duo idola fures deprehendentia, in medio civitatis collocavit, & CLXXX annos regnavit. Nathra F. qui civitatem Salcha & in regione Eluchat tres in columnis pofitas condidit. Mefram Frater, qui leonem ita domuit, ut & inc- quitaret, Talismata & imagines loquentes confti- tuit, & arcem in Oceano, in qua folis ftatua erecta, opera fine dubio Diabolorum exftruxiffe dicitur. Arkam facerdos, cujus tempore Enochum fubla- tum ferunt, Arick F. quo regnante fuere Haruth & Maruth. Hafilia, qui Nilometrum & duas a- quilas areas ftatuit, quarum mare fibilante, aquæ copia innuebatur, foeminâ defectus. Hufal, fub quo Noë, Surit poft Tatrafanum, Sarkakua & Schabirkum, qui primus canales in Ægypto fodit, & pyramides exftruxit, in quibus, cum omnibus thefauris fepultus eft. Hugit, Manaus feu Ma- nakau, Aphrus, Malinu, Abn Anan Phareun, fub quo diluvium, folis nominibus noti, omnes fiditii.
